verdict.rationale: ADK ships a built-in dev Web UI for testing/debugging/showcasing agents (google-adk-gh-3, google-adk-gh-4) and the framework is event-based, filtering/tracking events and token usage (google-adk-docs-12), which implies some real-time visibility into agent steps, but the evidence pack never explicitly describes a streaming API (SSE/WebSocket) for pushing tokens or tool-call events to a custom UI. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a streaming/events API for custom UIs, examples of token-by-token streaming, and independent confirmation of real-time tool-call visibility outside the built-in dev UI.
